findings.title: TestLogger.FromContext discards all logger state
findings.body: TestLogger.FromContext(_ context.Context) returns a brand-new NewTestLogger() instance instead of returning the receiver (or a logger that still writes into the same DebugLogs/InfoLogs/WarnLogs/ErrorLogs fields). Since LoggerMiddleware now always logs via `m.logger.FromContext(ctx).Info(...)` (see logger_middleware.go), any test using plog.NewTestLogger() to assert on logged messages/calls through code paths that call FromContext will never see those calls recorded on the original TestLogger instance - the call lands on a throwaway logger that is immediately discarded. This makes TestLogger unusable for verifying the new context-aware logging behavior and can mask real bugs in tests that rely on it.

findings.title: traceID field dropped from 'Plugin Request Completed' log line
findings.body: The previous logRequest implementation in logger_middleware.go explicitly added a "traceID" attribute to the log params via tracing.TraceIDFromContext(ctx, false). That code (and the tracing import) was removed in this PR, and the replacement contextual-attribute builder here (instrumentContext) only adds endpoint, pluginId, dsName, dsUID, and uname - traceID is not restored anywhere. As a result, the 'Plugin Request Completed' log entries emitted by LoggerMiddleware no longer contain a traceID, which is a regression for trace/log correlation that isn't mentioned in the PR description.

findings.title: No unit test added for new ContextualLoggerMiddleware
findings.body: This PR introduces a new, independently-registered middleware (ContextualLoggerMiddleware) that carries meaningful logic (building the contextual log attributes from plugin/datasource/user info and depending on being ordered before LoggerMiddleware in the chain). No test file (e.g., contextual_logger_middleware_test.go) was added to verify that the context attributes are correctly set, nor to guard against future middleware-order regressions that would silently break the LoggerMiddleware's enriched logging.

findings.title: Test function name not updated after rename
findings.body: The file was renamed from instrumentation_middleware_test.go to metrics_middleware_test.go and the underlying type/constructor were renamed to MetricsMiddleware/newMetricsMiddleware, but the test function is still named TestInstrumentationMiddleware. This leaves a stale, inconsistent name that no longer matches the renamed type or file, contrary to the stated goal of the PR (better naming/consistency).

findings.title: Adding FromContext to exported Logger interface is a breaking change for other implementers
findings.body: A new required method, FromContext(ctx context.Context) Logger, was added to the exported plugins/log.Logger interface. This PR only updates the two known implementations (grafanaInfraLogWrapper in logger.go and TestLogger in fake.go). Any other type in the codebase (or downstream consumer) that implements plugins/log.Logger without this method will fail to compile/satisfy the interface. This should be verified across the codebase before merging, since interface changes like this silently break unrelated implementers.

findings.title: Logger name still references old 'instrumentation' naming
findings.body: clientmiddleware.NewLoggerMiddleware(cfg, log.New("plugin.instrumentation")) still names the logger "plugin.instrumentation" even though this PR's stated purpose is to rename instrumentation-related concepts to metrics-related ones for clarity, and the logger here is purely for request logging (LoggerMiddleware), not metrics. This leaves confusing/incorrect logger naming in production logs after the rename.
